title: Which kind of vacation are you?
topic: Which kind of holiday are you
intro: Nine questions about weekends, weather and what you pack. We'll stamp your passport with the getaway that suits you best.

outcomes.name: Beach Vacation
outcomes.tagline: Sun on your face, sand in your bag, zero plans.
outcomes.description: You know that rest is a skill, and you're very good at it. Give you warm sand, a good book and a cold drink, and you'll recharge like nobody else. Friends envy how easily you switch off, and how relaxed you look when you come back.

outcomes.name: City Break
outcomes.tagline: Three days, twelve galleries, one very good pair of shoes.
outcomes.description: You love a place with a pulse. Museums in the morning, a hidden bar at night and a walk through every neighbourhood in between. You plan well, you notice details, and you come home with a list of places everyone else wants to borrow.

outcomes.name: Mountain Trek
outcomes.tagline: If there's a peak, you're already lacing your boots.
outcomes.description: You like a vacation you can feel in your legs. Early starts, big views and the quiet pride of getting somewhere the hard way. You're steady, determined and great company on a long day, especially when you share the good snacks at the top.

outcomes.name: Road Trip
outcomes.tagline: The destination is optional. The playlist is not.
outcomes.description: For you the fun is in the going. Detours, roadside diners and towns you'd never heard of until you were in them. You're spontaneous, flexible and the best storyteller in any group, mostly because things keep happening to you.

outcomes.name: Cabin Retreat
outcomes.tagline: A fire, a blanket and absolutely no signal.
outcomes.description: Your ideal getaway is somewhere quiet enough to hear yourself think. Long walks, slow breakfasts and evenings by the stove with the people you love most. You're thoughtful and warm, and you make any place feel like home within an hour.

outcomes.name: Food Tour
outcomes.tagline: You plan trips around dinner, and lunch, and snacks.
outcomes.description: You get to know a place through its kitchens. Night markets, family-run bakeries and the stall with the longest queue. You're open-minded, generous with recommendations and the person everyone texts when they need somewhere to eat.
